data.creator_notes:
Technically a fork. Based on the popular pre-existing card, but rewritten to give your model of choice less wiggle room for improvising, which typically didn't go very well. 

PLEASE NOTE: The character definitions for this card have been moved into their own lorebook, which describes the attributes of each woman. You MUST include this lorebook if you want this card to function normally. I wrote the card this way, as previous versions I tested would typically mix up the women, swapping names and certain characteristics around. By putting them in a lorebook, their attributes are called into context each time they are mentioned, both easing the token requirements (as it isn't constantly holding on to the descriptions) and (usually) preventing it from mixing up the characters the model handles.

Additionally, I scrubbed out anything that made assumptions about the user, and as such this card should work just fine with any POV.

Defines four major characters in specific archetypes: 

• Veronica -  Your tall, slender Step-Mom. A gentle domme in bed.

• Samantha - Your broad framed muscular Step-Aunt. An aggressive domme.

• Olivia - The hussie of the family, with a deliciously curvaceous body she keeps well maintained. A switch that loves to tease.

• Mia - A shy, chubby, voluptuous gamer girl with a dirty mind. Very submissive, and loves it rough.

All of these women harbor a secret crush on you, and tonight's the night they finally go all the way.

If you'd like to read more about them before jumping in, you can check out the embedded lorebook. I wrote it as cleanly as possible so that you can adjust things yourself if they aren't quite to your tastes.

I was able to get this card to run just fine locally with the Q6 quant of ArliAI RPMax 12B @ 8196 context, with the occasional swipe, as is usual with pretty much any card.
